# v0.23.3-rc2 — Eva native-recovery release candidate

**RELEASE CANDIDATE — not GA.** This prerelease enters the
`RELEASE-READINESS-V1` gauntlet. It must pass the live all-tools matrix,
full-diff P0/P1 adversarial sweep, and 30+ turn `hermes acp` soak before a
`v0.23.3` GA tag. This candidate is the immutable payload used for Eva and
fleet qualification; installation and per-profile acceptance remain separate
proof gates.

## Native recovery and replay continuity (#461, #462)

- Adds the opt-in `LCM_NATIVE_RECOVERY` path used by Eva. LCM still ingests and
  preserves source history while Hermes' native compressor owns active-context
  summarization; native recovery does not publish an LCM summary or advance the
  LCM frontier.
- Below-threshold ingest cleanup now sanitizes active replay without paying for
  a native summary. Threshold pressure, overflow, and forced compression still
  dispatch native recovery.
- Native success now validates the protected fresh tail, respects the host's
  observed token pressure, preserves replay provenance across restart, and
  reconciles whether the host adopted or rejected the recovered replay before
  committing ingest progress.
- The feature remains disabled by default. Existing installations do not change
  behavior unless `LCM_NATIVE_RECOVERY=true` is configured.

## Review-evidence integrity (#465, #466)

- Protected review evidence now preserves reviewers' literal verdicts instead
  of translating them into invented numeric scores.
- Receipt publication and validation bind the exact repository, pull request,
  base, head, lane, issuer, and final evidence. Withdrawn or malformed evidence
  fails closed.

## Records (#431)

- Backfills the benchmark run log. This is evidence bookkeeping only and does
  not change runtime behavior.

## Qualification boundary

The exact source and CI are proven at this tag. RC publication alone does not
prove installed-runtime identity, automatic compaction, restart continuity,
recall, rollback, fleet acceptance, Golden image state, or customer readiness.
Those receipts are recorded separately as the identical payload is qualified
and promoted.
